name: GreenSquareDC SYD1 Norwest Stage 1

address.note: former IBM/Kyndryl data centre; DA modification lists 1-9 Brookhollow Avenue

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 3 Brookhollow Avenue

mw_it.note: 'Alterations and additions to the existing 4MW data centre to provide for a 14.9MW data centre' (SSD-81928961 EIS Table 3, summarising 1382/2025/JP); operator/press round to 15MW; datacentermap lists 10.9MW phase

mw_grid.note: site power stated as 20MVA (DCD) - MVA, not converted

cost_aud_m.note: CIV $84,709,798 (planning panel PPSSCC-667 project page; EIS Table 3 EDC $84,709,798 excl GST)

authority.note: panel ref PPSSCC-667; regionally significant development (CIV > $30m); electronic determination as no submissions received

pathway.note: 'Alterations and Additions to an Existing Data Centre' (1-9 Brookhollow Ave, incl. subdivision into two lots); later s4.55(1A) modification 1382/2025/JP/A (Mar 2026). Partial demolition under CDC 25/250218-01 issued 9 Sep 2025

lodged.note: lodgement date per planning panel page and council assessment report ('lodged on 25 March 2025'); referred 26 Mar 2025

determined.note: approved; determination date 04/09/2025 (planning panel page; EIS for SSD-81928961 agrees)

jobs_construction.note: w.media 19 Oct 2026: 'About 400 people worked on site at peak time'

jobs_operational.note: council assessment report: 'the proposed development's 14.9MW capacity supports a staff estimate of 10 FTE' / 'maximum of 10 staff'; SSD-81928961 EIS: 'existing 10 operational FTE roles associated with Stage 1'

construction_start.note: w.media 19 Oct 2026: main construction works began in February 2026; 'completed and ready for service in eight months'. Enabling/demolition works under a CDC from Sep 2025 (source 1)

construction_end.note: GreenSquare announced 19 Oct 2026 that 'the first stage of its SYD1 data centre campus ... is now operational' (w.media, source 10); exact practical completion date not stated

open_questions: scope: refurbishment/refit of existing 1993 IBM/Kyndryl data centre (approved D93/318; 4MW -> 14.9MW) - may not count as a new facility
overlap: Stage 1 of same campus as greensquaredc-syd1 (Stage 2, SSD-81928961, 96MW IT)
mw_it of the stage now open not stated in the Oct 2026 announcement ('275 per cent increase in IT capacity', consistent with 4MW -> ~15MW)
